Settings.title: Settings
Settings.subtitle: Manage your account preferences
Settings.routingIntro: Your assigned processing method (<card>CARD</card> or <fork>FORK</fork>) is configured by platform staff. Incoming Pay-Ins first route to Fork vs Card by global traffic %; inside your tier, idle time and your cascade rating multiplier decide who gets the next assignment. You cannot switch tiers yourself—contact support if you need a different mode.
Settings.routingBulletFork: Fork: idle × max(fill_mult, trader_mult) (fill_mult scales with confirmed volume; new requisites get a short start boost on the fill ladder).
Settings.routingBulletCard: Card: idle × trader multiplier only (no fill ladder).
Settings.routingBulletFallback: If nothing matches on one tier, orders can fall back to the other tier and then to an external provider.
Settings.forkNote: FORK (exchange-style) flows often take longer to confirm than direct card transfers. Typical confirmation may be on the order of several minutes rather than one or two.
Settings.requisiteLink: View requisites and effective amount ranges
